items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: I got a picture of Big Mason.

ctx.x: He was the one made of a new ringlet out of a black girl. Everybody was talking about it. He had him in Arkansas, northern Mississippi. He was actually about the only song he was singing, but he played all poplar and blues. Yeah. What was his name? And late at night, he was one of them. He called him Florida Street Snooki. He was a little old dog guy. Wasn't tall as brook. And he played a lot of piano. A lot of left, a lot of left hand like Big Mason.
And he was like, oh, I got a picture of Big Mason.

items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: I was hanging around on a 29th wall back with Big Mason's back.

ctx.x: How long you had that picture? Oh, just a few weeks. Yeah. I got it from a friend of mine. He's dead now, I think.
Oh, yeah. He's on the ground. I was hanging around on a 29th wall back with Big Mason's back. It was a bad left hand, man. It was a bad left hand you want to see.
